captions: Argus watches business metrics while the team is away.
Ad spend moves out of range. Argus opens an investigation.
The agent chooses a check and records what it expects to find.
The check returns evidence. Argus uses it to decide what to test next.
Open the evidence receipt to see the query, its time and result hash.
The recorded result was verified against its source.
Could higher traffic explain the spend?
Ask Argus answers from the case evidence and links the supporting receipt.
Argus proposes rolling back the ad pacer for Germany and France.
The clock waits here for an operator decision.
I approve the rollback. Argus records the decision and applies it in the simulator.
Argus compares pacing after the rollback with the same simulation left untouched.
The effect check passes and links to the evidence from both worlds.
The morning report closes the loop with a record of what changed.
